description: Is an asking price fair? Compares it against registered DLD sales of the same layout (bedroom count) in the same building over the last 24 months: verdict vs the median, approximate percentile, resale-only median, and recent sales. No verdict when fewer than 5 sales back it. A negotiation guide, not a valuation. Takes the communitySlug + buildingSlug pair returned by search_locations.
name: check_asking_price
title: Check an asking price
